pages.title: Admin Commands
pages.text: All commands require permission level 2 and the right item in your hand.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales blacklist flee add|remove$() - hold a spawn egg to add/remove that mob from the never-flee list.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales blacklist exclude add|remove$() - hold a spawn egg to make that mob completely unaffected by this mod; some mobs with unusual breeding are excluded by default.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales blacklist bait add|remove$() - hold an item to add/remove it from the bait blacklist; listed items will not attract fish even if dropped in water.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales bait add|remove$() - hold an item to add/remove it from the bait whitelist; listed items work as bait even if they are not edible, and the blacklist wins if an item is on both.

pages.title: Diet Commands
pages.text: $(bold)/pasturetales customfood add [value]|remove$() - hold any item to make it animal food; without a value, its own nutrition is used.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales diet$() - hold a $(bold)spawn egg$() to see that mob's diet.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales diet add herbivore|carnivore|omnivore$() - set its diet.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales diet remove herbivore|carnivore$() - remove it from a diet list (back to omnivore).

pages.title: Oviparous Commands
pages.text: $(bold)/pasturetales oviparous add$() - hold that mob's spawn egg in your $(bold)main hand$() and the egg it lays in your $(bold)off hand$() to register it as oviparous; it no longer gets pregnant and instead lays eggs on a cycle like a chicken.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales oviparous remove$() - just hold the spawn egg in your main hand to remove it, and it goes back to live birth.$(br2)Changes are written straight to the config file. The mob must be an animal, and one mob can only map to one egg.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.text: Open the config screen from the Mods menu, or edit $(bold)pasturetales-common.toml$() in the config folder.$(br2)See $(l:animalflee:commands/config_overview)Common Settings$() for what you can change.$(br2)Most options apply immediately. One exception: whether an animal is born fearless is decided once per animal, so changing the ratio will not affect animals already decided.
